_comment: CDC task for the Kinesis target. Kinesis messages carry the FULL after image in 'data' (all columns, SQL Server CDC captures whole rows) and the FULL before image in 'before-image' (ColumnFilter=all) for updates/deletes. The Lambda builds items from these images (cdc-enrichment.yaml). Source retention: SQL Server CDC cleanup keeps 7 days (see sqlserver-source-endpoint.json).
